payload.text: 我现在要写一个翻译字幕的小程序，要求是传两个字幕文件，翻译对着原文进行对比进行校验，并且需要更加口语化，主要是在中文语境下

**Developing the Application Idea**

I'm solidifying the application's core functionality: a subtitle translation and validation tool. The user can upload two files (original and draft) or just the original. I'm focusing on the AI's role: translating or verifying, with a focus on making translations sound more natural and spoken in Chinese.


**Defining the Technical Stack**

I've decided on the technical stack: React, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS for the frontend. I'll be using the Gemini API through `@google/genai` for the AI integration. I'm structuring the application with file upload functionality for source and optional existing translation SRT/VTT files. I am currently fleshing out the real-time preview and editing of subtitle blocks as well.


**Optimizing Processing Efficiency**

I'm now prioritizing efficient processing of large subtitle files. I've settled on batch processing with the Gemini API, sending groups of subtitle blocks to avoid hitting token limits. I'm focusing on crafting specific prompts that emphasize natural, colloquial Chinese and context-aware translations. I have also decided on the self-correction feature of `gemini-3-pro-preview` with the system prompt updates. Also I have the folder structure set up.
